conf.description: Oracle Database Audit, listener, other (text listener.log): two-stage parse of the asterisk-delimited connect record - top-level star split, then a walk of the nested TNS (key=(key=value)) groups inside CONNECT_DATA and ADDRESS - per recommendations.direct.cribl. source.ip comes from the observed ADDRESS HOST; the client-asserted CID HOST is kept only as a claim, never overwriting it.

conf.comment: listener / other (text). Scoped to the 'establish' line shape - Timestamp * (CONNECT_DATA=...) * (ADDRESS=...) * Event * Service * ReturnCode - the only shape carrying a client network address; this is deliberately the security-relevant slice the catalogue calls out first. The service_register/service_update/reload housekeeping lines use a shorter, ADDRESS-less segment layout and will NOT match this regex (their fields stay unmapped) - consistent with the catalogue's own advice to suppress those for volume. TIMESTAMP has no offset or zone (DD-MON-YYYY local time) - no per-host timezone table was supplied, so _time is a best-effort Date.parse with no offset correction (gap). These nested-paren regexes are unverified against a real listener.log sample - tune against production data before go-live.

functions.description: top-level asterisk split of the establish-line shape: timestamp, the whole CONNECT_DATA(...) blob, the whole ADDRESS(...) blob, event, the trailing SID|Service segment (not in this work order's field list, dropped unmapped), return code
walk the CONNECT_DATA sub-groups: SERVICE_NAME or SID (mutually exclusive), and the nested CID PROGRAM/HOST/USER triple
walk the ADDRESS sub-group: PROTOCOL/HOST/PORT of the observed client connection
batch rename every straight-copy capture; CID HOST goes to a custom claim field, never source.ip, so the observer-verified ADDRESS HOST is not silently overwritten by the client's own assertion

computed fields from the raw stage-1/2/3 captures (tcps flagged as TLS-wrapped TNS per the catalogue's note, port/return code cast to number, outcome derived from the return code), then drop every intermediate capture and blob field; tag event.dataset for the shared logs-oracle.listener stream
Re-nest flat dotted keys (data-maps canonical step)
